plot: At sunset in Grandma's living room Max must stay awake until the clock rings eight times for Grandma's surprise, but Bird's jumping, Mouse's tickle and Dog's game of fetch all end in naps, until Bird works out that Dog's kind refills of warm milk were making Max sleepy; cold water and fresh air keep him awake and the surprise is a cake for Max's one-year Home Day.

script.title: Will Max Fall Asleep Before the Surprise?

beats.say: Yawwwn! Whoa... my eyes are closing all by themselves!
Max, wake up! Can you stay awake for the big surprise?
It is sunset in Grandma's cozy living room.
When the big clock rings eight times, my surprise is ready!
Until then, nobody peeks in the kitchen. Here, Max. Warm milk.
Warm milk with honey. Max drinks it all. Slurp, slurp!
Mmm, yummy! Eight rings? No problem at all. I am wide awake!
I will be your wake-up buddy. Nobody naps on my watch!
See? Eyes open. Ears up. Tail up. A super awake cat!
Good! Now we just wait. And wait. And wait...
The big clock rings once. DING! Seven more to go.
Yawwwn... why is this room so soft and warm?
No sleeping! Quick, jump up and down with me!
Jump! Jump! Jump! Jump!
Max jumps so much, he gets dizzy and flops on the rug.
This rug is so fluffy. Just one tiny nap...
Max! I brought you more warm milk! Milk makes you strong!
Thank you, Dog. Slurp, slurp... Yawwwn.
Drink it all up! Strong cats never get sleepy!
DING, DING! The clock rings two more times. Five to go!
Max! If you fall asleep now, you miss the whole surprise!
Leave it to me! Nobody sleeps through the Mouse tickle!
Mouse tickles Max's nose with her tiny tail. Tickle, tickle.
Ha... ha... HA-CHOO!
The big sneeze blows Mouse right onto the sofa. Boing!
Oops! Well, at least that sneeze woke you up!
Thanks, Mouse! Now I will hold my eyes open with my paws!
But holding eyes open is hard. Soon his paws get sleepy too.
Max! Even your paws are snoring!
It did! I am awake. I am awake. I am... zzz.
I know! Fetch keeps everybody awake! Go get the ball, Max!
Dog throws the red ball across the rug. Max runs after it...
...and curls up around it like a soft round pillow.
Max, that is not fetch. That is a nap with a ball!
He's snoring on the ball! Dog, what do we do now?
Easy. My loudest bark. Ready? One, two... WOOF!
Max wakes up so fast, he bounces right up in the air!
Who? What? Was that eight rings? Did I miss it?
Not yet! But you snored right through three rings!
DING! That makes six rings now. Only two to go!
Only two rings left! If Max sleeps now, it's all for nothing!
Don't worry! One more cup of warm milk will save him!
Wait! Dog... how many cups of milk did Max drink?
One from Grandma. One from me. And this one makes three!
Three cups of WARM milk! That is why Max is so sleepy!
My mama gives me warm milk at bedtime. It makes you sleepy!
Oh no. I was helping Max sleep, not helping him wake!
It's okay, Dog. You were being kind. But what now?
Cold water, a big stretch, and fresh air by the window!
And no more warm milk! Dog, put that cup down, please.
Okay, okay. I will drink it myself. Slurp... Yawwwn.
Max sips cold water. Brrr! His whiskers stand straight up.
He stretches tall, tall, tall by the open window.
Whoa! The cool air tickles my ears. My eyes are open!
Look at him! Bright eyes! Wiggly tail! A wide-awake cat!
Shh! Listen, everybody! Here comes the very last ring!
The big clock rings one last time. DING!
Surprise! One whole year ago today, Max came home to us!
A cake just for me? I stayed awake! I did it!
Hooray for Max! And no more warm milk tonight!
When friends help, they ask first what you really need.
Tomorrow, let's find out what Dog dreams about! Yawwwn... zzz.
